reviews.evidence: Full linking and dependency review. The Poincaré disk mention now links to differential-geometry/poincare-disk-model. The Laplace–Beltrami link and eigenvalue sign agree with the nonnegative convention declared by differential-geometry/laplace-beltrami-operator. Kapovich, Curves, Surfaces, and Hyperbolic Geometry, §1.1.2, pp. 19–20, gives the disk metric, orthogonal-circle geodesics, and ideal boundary. Helgason, Groups and Geometric Analysis, Ch. I, §3, supports the hyperbolic Poisson/plane-wave construction.

Full definition review. Farb and Margalit, A Primer on Mapping Class Groups, Chapter 1, §1.1.2, pp. 19–20, explicitly presents the open unit disk with metric 4(dx²+dy²)/(1−|z|²)², identifies its geodesics and unit-circle ideal boundary, and states its isometry with the upper-half-plane model. Prerequisite and link targets parse and resolve.
